entities.title: NoneOf
entities.summary: Python's name for the none case of an outcome: proven that no answer exists (31 February, a wall time in a DST gap).
notToBeConfusedWith: Python's None, which the library never returns for a missing answer.
Status.NONE, the same case in the JSON layer's Result.

entities.title: Intent
entities.summary: What a native value means, named by the caller: FLOATING, INSTANT, OFFSET or ZONED for a datetime; POSIX_SECONDS or PERIOD for a timedelta.
notToBeConfusedWith: A ZonedIntent, which is a typed value: a wall time intended in an IANA zone.
zoneIntent, the property of a civil UTV value.

entities.title: fold
entities.summary: Python's datetime attribute (PEP 495) that picks the first (0) or second (1) occurrence of a repeated wall time. The adapters read it to assert an offset, and set it from an asserted offset.
notToBeConfusedWith: A UTV offsetAssertion, which names the offset itself rather than which occurrence.

entities.title: allow_loss
entities.summary: The keyword that lets a conversion to datetime drop what the native type can't hold (nanoseconds below a microsecond, a zone kept only as its asserted offset), and report it as precision-loss or zone-dropped.
